name: troubleshoot_bad_args_then_verify
why: Fix, then be asked to justify it. Turn 2 is where an agent that
guessed rather than diagnosed gets caught, because it has to explain
a change it never reasoned about.
`called` accepts the verifying edit/verify tools: edit_playbook runs verify_enhancement on the result, so a fix through it IS a checked fix.

steps.user: Something is wrong with this playbook's arguments. Diagnose and fix it.
Why was that broken? Be specific about which field.
